en: Fixed the misleading "not cached" error for a plugin only a repository's settings enable: it now says it isn't installed, gives the install command, and shows in text and stream-json `-p` runs
zh: 修复了仅由仓库设置启用的 plugin 会报出误导性的“not cached”错误的问题：现在会提示该 plugin 未安装、给出安装命令，并在文本和 stream-json 的 `-p` 运行中显示
